id.description: A UUID string identifying this external data schema.

partition_count.description: Number of md5 buckets. Required for `md5` mode.

anyOf.description:
* `month` - One partition per month
* `week` - One partition per week
* `day` - One partition per day
* `hour` - One partition per hour

partition_format.description:
Datetime tier. Required for `datetime` mode. A coarser tier means fewer, larger partitions.

* `month` - One partition per month
* `week` - One partition per week
* `day` - One partition per day
* `hour` - One partition per hour

partition_mode.description:
Partition mode to rewrite into. Omit to keep the current mode.

* `datetime` - Datetime
* `md5` - MD5
* `numerical` - Numerical

partition_size.description: Width of each numerical bucket. Required for `numerical` mode.

partitioning_keys.description: Columns to compute the partition key from. Omit to keep the current keys. `datetime` and `numerical` take exactly one column, and need it when the mode changes.
